limerick.description: Drives a running Limerick/Rundale instance (limerick-tauri --mcp-port 3030 or limerick-server --port 3030). Tools: limerick_world_snapshot, limerick_map, limerick_npcs_here, limerick_save_state, limerick_submit_input, limerick_new_game, limerick_save_game, limerick_load_branch, plus a tauri_invoke escape hatch. The backend MUST be running first — see AGENTS.md or run `bash limerick/scripts/limerick-mcp-backend.sh start`.
